title: Accelerating Ptychography Algorithm Development with Reasoning Large Language Models
content: Trained on vast and diverse textual datasets, large language models (LLMs) exhibit broad scientific knowledge and demonstrate promising performance across a wide range of scientific tasks. As a result, their integration into scientific research has gained increasing interest [1, 2, 3]. Particularly in electron ptychography, LLMs have proven highly effective in automating complex tasks such as experimental controls and data analysis [4]. Recently, a new class of reasoning LLMs [5, 6] has emerged, characterized by their advanced step-by-step problem-solving capabilities, proficiencies in mathematics and coding, and their ability to derive sophisticated insights [7, 8]. These models have great potential to leverage structured reasoning to discover new theories, achieve unprecedented precision in deep analysis, and rapidly enable novel methodologies and algorithms.
